text: I can run the five-step estimation method out loud without notes.
I can turn DAU and actions per user into average and peak QPS, split by reads and writes.
I can compute storage per year with replication, and ingress/egress bandwidth.
I can recall the key latency ratios: memory vs SSD vs network vs cross-continent.
I can convert nines to downtime and compute availability for serial and redundant parts.
